newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE remains firm, production problems ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE remains firm, production problems ease.

text.p: Prompt U.S. MTBE prices remained high Thursday morning as strong demand continued to force buyers to fight for few supplies.
A blender bought a 25,000-barrel parcel of prompt New York Harbor at 101.75 cents this morning, and sellers remained at 102.50 cents.
U.S. Gulf prompt MTBE firmed a cent to 96.50/97.50 cents.
Meanwhile, although supplies remain tight the production problems that have harassed this market have appeared to ease.

SuperOctanos, the 12,500 bpd plant in Venezuela, shot down rumors it had declared force majeure and said it will begin to restart its downed plant on Friday. The plant had been offline for an extended turnaround because of technical difficulties.
Enron also denied rumors its Morgan's Point, Texas, plant was down, and said the rumors were spread by players trying to talk the market higher.
In addition, Belvieu Environmental Fuels is bringing back up early from turnaround its 15,000 bpd Texas plant to take advantage of market conditions, players said.
"The production problems are not as severe as talked about yesterday but the fact of the matter is there is still not a whole lot of excess MTBE around," said a Houston player.
